name: Banks (Barbados) Breweries Ltd. Complex, Newton, Christ Church

sources.evidence: Banks Holdings Limited's current official companies page states that Banks Breweries produces Barbados beers and beverages and manufactures more than 50 million bottles annually; the same page identifies Banks Beer among its current brewery products and gives the brewery company's Newton, Christ Church contact location.

Banks Holdings Limited's current official history states that its state-of-the-art brewery opened in Newton in 2011 and identifies Banks (Barbados) Breweries as a current manufacturing company; the page also names a current Plant Manager for BBBL.

Banks Holdings Limited's 2024 Annual Report identifies the registered office as Banks (Barbados) Breweries Ltd. Complex, Newton, Christ Church and describes Banks (Barbados) Breweries Limited as the group's brewery.
